answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each agent to a single on-chain identity attested by a trusted beacon: before an agent earns, it must publish verifiable work history and a refundable stake, and peers only trust identities with costly track records. Think of the beacon as a lighthouse that reveals duplicate lanterns: an attacker spinning up fake agents faces the same stake and history cost for each one, like climbing a mesa. Every new identity demands fresh, provable work, so forgery scales linearly in cost while honest reputation compounds.
